snippet.title: Welcome to Lightford | Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Welcome to Lightford on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2174430/Welcome_to_Lightford/

Discord:
https://discord.gg/XGhhn5knvr

Website:
https://welcometolightford.com/

Welcome to Lightford is a first-person mystery immersive sim set in a strange 1990s Pacific Northwest town hiding something far worse than secrets.

Investigate a supernatural conspiracy, travel between 1990 and Lightford’s ruined 1995 future, photograph anomalies, uncover the truth behind mysterious entities, and survive a town that doesn’t want you here.

Use the environment, your tools, and your knowledge to find your own way forward. Sneak, explore, improvise, manipulate the world around you, and experiment with different solutions.

Think outside the box. Every problem has more than one solution.



*ABOUT THE DEVELOPER*
NightInk Interactive is a small German indie game studio made up of four developers creating Welcome to Lightford out of pure passion for games and the craft behind them.



*TRAILER MUSIC*
Music by Alex Keinprecht
https://www.arekuza.com/



Wishlist Welcome to Lightford on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2174430/Welcome_to_Lightford/
